scientific_integrity: Analytic global optimality proof using convex symmetrization, positive three-mode certificate, Fourier-spectrum verification, and independent finite numerical checks.
scientific_limitations: Optimizer uniqueness proved among rotation-invariant chains, not all edge-asymmetric feasible matrices.
Only real symmetric nonnegative stochastic matrices with uniform stationary distribution are optimized.
Finite numerical tests corroborate but do not prove the infinite-family theorem.
Absolute priority relative to inaccessible specialized work is not established.
title: Exact fastest-mixing probabilities on Möbius ladders
